3 03-02-2026 Heard Mrs. Shashi Priya, learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
"for directing the respondents to pay compensation amount to the petitioners for the land acquired by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Sitamarhi bearing Khata No.
543, Khesra No. 1587, Rakwa acquired-0.142 hectare situated on NH-77 under the powers conferred by sub- section (1) of the Section 3A of the National Highways Act,
1956 (48 of 1956) for the purposes of stretching the National Highway."

3. Issue notice to the respondent nos. 3.1 to 3.4 Patna High Court CWJC No.23478 of 2018(3)
dt.03-02-2026 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of two weeks failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
4.

In case, the order passed is not complied and the matter accordingly stands dismissed,
subsequently, the same be posted under the heading 'To be Mentioned'.
